name: ctrscm
description: Mechanically externalize old tool-result text during compaction while preserving conversation text and tool calls. Recover original output from paged local artifacts; fall back to built-in compaction when Shake cannot safely save enough context.

protectTokens.title: Protected recent context
protectTokens.description: Estimated tokens of recent context protected from Shake.

minSavings.title: Minimum savings
minSavings.description: Minimum estimated token savings required to apply Shake.

minResultTokens.title: Minimum result size
minResultTokens.description: Minimum estimated tokens in an eligible tool result.

protectedTools.title: Protected tools
protectedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results are never externalized.

fallback.title: Shake fallback
fallback.description: Use built-in compaction or skip when Shake is not applied.
